ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Description:
Neutralization / Azure Circuit
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Circular-template Neutralization Areas are centered on the four Antennas. Hyperthermal Techs are 25 mm reserve tokens. Exclusion zone: 4 inches each side of center.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/27ef9160-bb5e-40b0-92e8-a7271ad38558
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
